scientific_integrity: The analytic proof establishes all infinite-domain statements; finite rational checks are auxiliary. Scheme, positivity, local stability and non-global behavior of other variants are acknowledged prior knowledge.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for conservative-stage MPRK22(1/2), symmetric two-state exchange, strictly positive states and finite positive steps in exact arithmetic; no independent publication-priority audit.
title: Sharp global contraction and overshoot thresholds for symmetric MPRK22
